bio: One of the nation’s most energetic and inspiring Bible teachers, Howard Hendricks has shared the Word in more than 80 countries around the world. He has also written more than a dozen books on family life and Christian discipleship. Dr. Hendricks is a distinguished professor and Chairman of the Center for Christian Leadership at Dallas Theological Seminary. He has also served on the board of directors for The Navigators and Ronald Blue & Co.
